channel.title: Adgent — the blog
channel.description: Diagnostics, audits and honest reads on Meta and Google Ads accounts.

item.title: How to choose an AI media buying tool
item.description: AI ad tools split into four categories: creative generation, bid automation, analysis and diagnostics, and DSPs. A neutral framework for picking one.

item.title: Can AI audit your ad accounts?
item.description: AI audits ad accounts well for wasted spend, cross-platform reads and tracking gaps, but hits a ceiling on strategy. An honest look at both sides.

item.title: Why Performance Max isn’t spending your full budget
item.description: Performance Max not spending your budget? It usually isn't a budget problem — bid targets and Quality Score are likelier. A diagnostic ranked by likelihood.

item.title: Google Ads CPA rise: Aug 2026 bidding change
item.description: On 17 August 2026 Google made budget-limited campaigns spend up to the Target CPA/ROAS. If you beat your target, your CPA rose. Here's the read.

item.title: Google Ads account structure in 2026
item.description: In 2026, Google Ads structure is about signal quality, not manual control: STAGs of 3-10 keywords, a Brand/Non-brand split, 30+ conversions per campaign.

item.title: Why is my Meta ROAS dropping? A diagnostic walkthrough
item.description: Meta ROAS dropping? Most drops are signal problems, not campaign problems. Check tracking, scaling, saturation, fatigue and attribution — in that order.

item.title: Why did my CPA suddenly jump? What to check first
item.description: A CPA spike is usually one of four things: a tracking break, a learning reset, auction/CPM pressure, or creative fatigue. The ranked checklist to find it fast.

item.title: Is Performance Max cannibalizing your branded search?
item.description: Performance Max often takes credit for branded demand you'd win for free — inflating its ROAS while adding nothing. Here's how to spot it and stop it.

item.title: Meta vs Google Ads: which for your first $10k?
item.description: Google Ads captures demand people have; Meta creates it. Which to start with depends on whether people search for what you sell. An honest side-by-side.

item.title: The Meta Ads audit: ten checks that recover spend
item.description: Audit a Meta Ads account in order of recoverable spend: verify pixel and CAPI signal first, then attribution, CBO leakage, placement drift and creative fatigue.

item.title: How to audit a Performance Max campaign
item.description: Performance Max hides where the money goes. The checks that pierce the black box, ranked by impact: brand-spend detection and tracking first.

item.title: How much ad budget is wasted?
item.description: WordStream's study of 15,666 accounts puts average wasted spend near a third of budget. A ranked playbook for finding each leak and pricing it.

item.title: CBO vs ABO vs Advantage+: which budget model in 2026?
item.description: Pick by what you're buying: ABO to test each option fairly, CBO to scale known winners, Advantage+ when you trust your signal and want Meta to run it.

item.title: Can AI run your ad account? What it can and can't do
item.description: AI can do the reads, diagnosis and drafting — but it shouldn't hold the last click on live spend. What AI does well in ad management, and what stays human.

item.title: AI media buyer for agencies, many accounts
item.description: An AI media buyer puts senior judgment on every client account: the same nightly read, verdict-first brief and approval-gated fixes, one account at a time.

item.title: What is an AI media buyer? A plain-language guide
item.description: An AI media buyer reads your ad accounts like a senior strategist, says what to do and why, and executes on your approval. How it differs from a dashboard.

item.title: How to audit a Google Ads account: 12-point checklist
item.description: A practical Google Ads audit checklist: conversion tracking, wasted search terms, placement leakage, bid strategy and pacing — ranked by recoverable spend.

item.title: AI media buyer vs PMax vs dashboard
item.description: Three tools, three jobs: a dashboard reports, Performance Max optimizes the auction, an AI media buyer reasons for you. Which one you need, honestly.

item.title: The 7-day window is lying to you before noon
item.description: Meta's 7-day click window keeps rewriting yesterday's ROAS. Why day-one data reads pessimistic by construction — and how to decide anyway.

item.title: How to scale a winner without breaking it
item.description: The 20% rule, learning-phase resets, and why the speed of a budget increase matters more than its size. How to scale Meta campaigns without a reset.

item.title: Frequency is a lagging indicator. Watch CPM.
item.description: By the time frequency says your audience is tired, your cost already moved. Why the CPM curve calls creative fatigue days earlier.

item.title: Why Adgent leads with the verdict
item.description: The design principle behind every Adgent brief: conclusion first, evidence underneath, nothing you didn't need. Why dashboards never hand you a decision.

item.title: Placement drift: the leak hiding in your average
item.description: A blended ROAS of 3.8x can hide a placement returning 1.1x. How Advantage+ placements drift, and how to find the leak inside a healthy number.

item.title: CBO vs ABO in 2026: when each still wins
item.description: Campaign budget optimization isn't always the answer. A decision tree for CBO vs ABO based on volume, audience symmetry, and what you're testing.

item.title: Meta says 4.2×, Google says 3.1×. Both are right.
item.description: Why Meta and Google ROAS can't be compared directly — different windows, models, and definitions — and how to build a comparability boundary.
